notes: tapFrac is a normalised SCREEN point from the top-left. UI taps are computed from the real RectTransform over the 1242x2688 panel with the letterbox correction: the CanvasScaler expands to 1242x2760 on the 1080x2400 device and AspecterSA centres a 1242x2688 panel inside it, so a panel point at y lands at (1380 - y) / 2760 from the top and a panel point at x lands at 0.5 + x / 1242. World taps (the baskets) need no correction - the camera fills the screen, so a basket at (i-1)*slotW with slotW = 2*halfW*0.92/3 sits at 0.5 +/- 0.92/3 across, and a basket at -0.59*halfH sits at 0.795 down. Step 1 blocks on the loader because the menu scene shows the template splash on a cold launch too; a fixed wait there would photograph the loading bar and offset every later tap by one screen. Both overlay sheets use their own dimmed surround as a close control, so a press that misses the corner glyph cannot leave a sheet covering the board. The day clock is 110 s and nothing can end the round without input, so every gameplay frame here lands inside a live round; the pause card also releases itself after 9 s, so a missed RESUME cannot park the capture.
